world.title: An academic's death foretold: Prof Jason Arday has passed, but the “playbook” he mentioned lives
world.summary: Professor Jason Arday has passed away, prompting reflections on his contributions to academia and the ongoing challenges of diversity within the field. His experiences highlight the contradictions in the celebration of diversity in Western academia. Arday's insights, shared during the British Sociological Association’s 75th annual conference, continue to resonate, emphasizing the need for genuine commitment to inclusivity.

world.title: British couple on honeymoon die in helicopter crash on Greek island; pilot also killed
world.summary: A British couple on their honeymoon died in a helicopter crash on the Greek island of Sifnos on Monday. The crash also claimed the life of the pilot. The incident occurred shortly before the couple was scheduled to arrive at their destination. Authorities are investigating the cause of the crash, which has shocked the local community.

world.title: Ukraine aims a drone blitz at Moscow as Russian missiles kill 10 in a Ukrainian village
world.summary: Ukrainian forces launched a significant drone attack on Russia, deploying nearly 800 drones, marking one of their largest offensives since the invasion began over four years ago. This escalation follows recent missile strikes in Kharkiv that resulted in the deaths of ten civilians. The situation highlights the ongoing violence and tensions between Ukraine and Russia as hostilities continue to intensify.

business.title: 13 million phones, end China production
business.summary: Google plans to cease production in China by next year, according to a new report. The company aims to sell approximately 13 million Pixel phones in 2026. This decision marks a significant step in Google's ongoing efforts to shift its manufacturing operations away from China, aligning with broader industry trends and geopolitical considerations impacting technology production.

business.title: Apple shares owner since its IPO days, Florida billionaire buys Ferrari’s first EV, designed by iPhone designer Jony Ive; 87-year-old is 'known for' never selling ...
business.summary: Florida billionaire Herbert A. Wertheim, a longtime Apple investor, has purchased the first production Ferrari Luce for $40 million. The Luce is Ferrari's inaugural fully electric vehicle, designed by Jony Ive, known for his work on the iPhone. At 87 years old, Wertheim is recognized for his strategy of never selling his investments.

business.title: Royal Enfield Classic 350 Gorkha Edition Launch Price Rs 2.10 L
business.summary: Royal Enfield has launched the Classic 350 Gorkha Edition in India, priced at Rs 2,10,684 (ex-showroom, New Delhi). The motorcycle features an exclusive green color scheme and unique insignia, inspired by the legacy of the Gorkha Regiment. Bookings for this special edition have begun as of August 18, 2026, marking its entry into the market.

technology.title: iPhone 18 Pro: 7 New Features Reportedly Coming With Apple’s 2026 Launch
technology.summary: Apple plans to alter its iPhone launch schedule in 2026, with the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max expected in September, while the standard iPhone 18 may be delayed until early 2027. Reports suggest seven new features will be introduced with the Pro models. This change marks a significant shift in Apple's traditional iPhone release strategy.

technology.title: Roundup: Here's What The Critics Are Saying About The Sinking City 2
technology.summary: Reviews for The Sinking City 2, a sequel to the 2019 game, are largely positive. Critics are sharing their thoughts on the survival horror title, highlighting its engaging elements and improvements over the original. The game features a mix of suspense and exploration, aiming to captivate players with its narrative and atmosphere. Overall, early impressions suggest a successful follow-up.

technology.title: Apple may increase iPhone 17 prices globally amid rising storage chip costs.
technology.summary: Apple is set to adjust prices for the iPhone 17 series globally by the end of August, according to Huo Xing Finance. This decision comes in response to rising memory chip costs, which have surged recently. The price increase could reach up to RMB 1,000 per device, reflecting the ongoing challenges in the semiconductor market.

sports.title: After 1,800 km dash, reserves Ashith Surya-Amrutha Pramuthesh endure golden point heartbreak
sports.summary: Ashith Surya and Amrutha Pramuthesh competed in the mixed doubles draw at the Karnataka State Senior Championships in Dharwad. After traveling 1,800 km, the second-seeded pair faced disappointment in the quarter-finals, losing in a golden point tiebreaker. Their performance highlighted the challenges of the tournament, as they aimed for success but ultimately fell short in a close match.

sports.title: Time ticking as Barcelona ready to activate Julian Alvarez Plan B in ‘two or three days’
sports.summary: Barcelona's pursuit of Julian Alvarez from Atletico Madrid is nearing its conclusion as the La Liga season approaches. With the team's first match against Elche scheduled for Sunday, time is running out to finalize the transfer. The club is reportedly preparing to activate a backup plan within the next two to three days if Alvarez's signing does not materialize.

sports.title: Arsenal make final push to sign Julian Alvarez, have backup plan
sports.summary: Arsenal is set to make a final effort to acquire 26-year-old Argentine international Julian Alvarez from Atletico Madrid this summer. Reports indicate that Barcelona is also interested in the player. In addition to their primary target, Arsenal is preparing a backup plan in case their attempt to sign Alvarez does not succeed before the transfer window closes.

health.title: Menopause may be India's most overlooked marriage challenge, say wellness advocates Swati Singh and Reshma Tiwari
health.summary: Menopause is frequently viewed solely as a women's health issue, but its effects can significantly impact marriages in India. Wellness advocates Swati Singh and Reshma Tiwari highlight that insufficient awareness about perimenopause and menopause creates challenges for couples, leading to difficulties in managing changes in mood, sleep, and energy. Addressing this issue is crucial for healthier relationships.

health.title: DNA damage could be causing Huntington’s disease. Study opens door to a new way to treat
health.summary: A study by Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory published in Nature Communications suggests that DNA damage may contribute to Huntington’s disease, a fatal brain disorder. The research highlights an overlooked aspect of the disease, where individuals possess a mutated gene with excessive nucleotide repeats. This finding could lead to new treatment approaches, shifting focus from solely correcting the genetic mutation.

science.title: California scientists poisoned invasive Argentine ant colonies with two common baits; one sent workers roaming before death, the other made them stop searching for food and cluster near water
science.summary: California scientists from the University of California, Riverside, studied the effects of two common bait treatments on invasive Argentine ant colonies. One bait caused workers to roam before dying, while the other made them stop searching for food and cluster near water. The findings suggest that an increase in visible ants after treatment does not necessarily indicate treatment failure.

science.title: Canadian Arctic Archipelago: 5 islands worth exploring
science.summary: The Canadian Arctic Archipelago features five islands worth exploring, showcasing stunning landscapes. Baffin Island, the largest, offers vast wilderness with rugged terrain, towering mountains, and deep fjords. It hosts several national parks, including Auyuittuq National Park, known for its dramatic scenery and outdoor activities. The region remains largely unexplored, attracting adventurers seeking unique natural beauty and remote experiences.

entertainment.title: CINTAA row deepens as Upasana Singh accuses Poonam Dhillon and Padmini Kolhapure of 'Dictatorship': 'Show-cause notices to those people who don't say 'yes, madam' to them'
entertainment.summary: The dispute within the Cine and TV Artistes Association (CINTAA) intensifies as general secretary Upasana Singh accuses president Poonam Dhillon and senior vice president Padmini Kolhapure of authoritarian behavior. Singh claims that show-cause notices are issued to members who do not comply with their demands. Former treasurer Deepak Parashar has also voiced concerns regarding the leadership's conduct.

entertainment.title: Vijay Varma roasts Dolly Singh for calling him ‘biggest red flag’ on stage. Watch
entertainment.summary: At the Indian Film Festival of Melbourne, actor Vijay Varma humorously responded to Dolly Singh, who referred to him as the "biggest red flag" on stage. Varma playfully dismissed her compliments as "terrible." Known for his roles with complex characters, Varma has gained recognition for performances in projects like "Darlings" and "Dahaad." The exchange showcased their lighthearted rapport.

entertainment.title: Exclusive: Two Titles Registered For NTR × Trivikram
entertainment.summary: Jr NTR and director Trivikram Srinivas are collaborating on a highly anticipated film, generating significant excitement among fans. Recent updates indicate that NTRArts has registered two titles for the project. While the titles have not been fully disclosed, they are expected to reflect the film's themes. Further details about the film's storyline and release date remain unconfirmed.
